landmarks.what: phase create records base_commit at fork time; pre-field records resolve a fork point from base + own commits and cache it back
three-way verdict (reachable / unreachable / cannot-determine) scoped to origin's tracking refs; shallow and no-origin-refs are indeterminate, a missing object is a hard unreachable
red_proof record (sha + doc) on changes.Changes; pins discovered by globbing phases/*/changes.json so a later phase's proof is checked with no new code

landmarks.what: dross phase red-proof set validates sha + doc and records the pin, so a machine-checked artefact is never hand-edited; live config-trust-hardening pin recorded

landmarks.what: doctor Red proofs section: unreachable pin is an issue naming doc + SHA + the phase's fork point to repoint to, shallow/no-origin-refs is a warning, doc/record disagreement is an issue
fixture suite reads its pin through discovery and classifies via classifyReachability; a gate fails the build if this file asks git a containment question of its own
falls back to the main branch when the recorded base branch no longer resolves, so doctor's repoint hint names a real commit for completed phases whose milestone branch is long gone
